name: Afcon Holdings Ltd
summary: Afcon Holdings Ltd develops and executes solutions for construction projects in Israel and internationally. It provides electric charging solutions; generates electricity from wind energies; delivers hybrid systems and technological solutions for dealing with water and wastewater; and markets, sells, installs, and maintains green technologies. The company also conducts projects in the field of end-to-end communication solutions and security systems, as well as in energy storage and renewable energies; installs multimedia and low-voltage; and develops and delivers communication services, infrastructure, and telecom solutions.
